title: Poseidon
objective: After this level you can describe Poseidon, god of the sea and earthquakes.
summary: Poseidon drew the sea by lot; with his trident he also ruled earthquakes and horses, and myths said he punished Argos after losing it to Hera.

cards.headline: The Greek god of the sea was also the god of earthquakes.
cards.body: Sea, shaking ground and horses: an odd set of jobs for one god. Meet Poseidon.

cards.headline: Lord of the sea
cards.body: Remember Level 42’s lottery? When Zeus and his brothers split the world, the sea fell to Poseidon. In a land where the sea opened up wider horizons (Level 2), that was a big realm. His weapon and main symbol was the trident, perhaps once a fish spear. The Romans later matched him with their own sea god, Neptune. The mightiest weapon in the sea may have started as fishing gear.

cards.headline: The earth-shaker
cards.body: Poseidon ruled more than water. He was the god of earthquakes, and Greeks called him enosichthōn, “earth-shaker”. He was the god of horses as well; in some myths he created the horse. The same god who stirred the waves could rattle the ground under your feet. Wherever things heaved, rolled or galloped, Poseidon was in charge.

cards.headline: A sore loser
cards.body: Poseidon wanted cities, too. He contested Argos with Hera, and lost. In one version he flooded the land in revenge. In the version the ancient writer Pausanias tells, he made the rivers of Argos disappear, which is why, Pausanias says, they give no water except after rain. A myth that doubles as a weather report.

mascot.line: Sound familiar? In Level 21 he lost Athens to Athena, too.

questions.prompt: Besides the sea, which two things did Poseidon rule?
questions.explanation: Poseidon was god of the sea, earthquakes and horses; the Greeks called him “earth-shaker”.

questions.prompt: In the story Pausanias tells, why do the rivers of Argos run dry except after rain?

options.label: Hera drained them to punish the city
Poseidon made them vanish after losing Argos to Hera
Zeus struck their springs with a thunderbolt
Heroes diverted them to clean a stable

questions.explanation: When the rivers judged Argos to Hera, Poseidon made their waters disappear, so they give no water except after rain.

questions.prompt: According to the myth in Level 42, how did Poseidon come to rule the sea?

options.label: He won it from Zeus in single combat
options.rationale: The brothers fought the Titans together.

options.label: Cronus left it to him in his will
He drew it by lot when the brothers split the world
The Cyclopes elected him its king

questions.explanation: After beating the Titans, Zeus, Poseidon and Hades drew lots: sky for Zeus, sea for Poseidon, underworld for Hades.
